fig2d_agreement.definition: Share of stores on which two loads agree on "a sandboxed ad pixel sent a request" (Default vs its repeat; GPC vs its repeat; emulated GPC vs Brave native GPC), with the Wilson 95% interval from analysis/common.py.
fig2d_agreement.check: k, n equal stats.json validation.*.agree / n; store_table.csv flags reproduce them where present

tableS_arms.definition: Start of the passive mouse-wheel scrolls, in seconds after the load event (design.first_scroll_after_load_ms / 1000), for the Action column of Supplementary Table S-arms.

fig2a_not_drawn.definition: Flagged domains of the 100k-200k Tranco bucket that were never drawn for checking (the bucket was checked in a seeded random order until its quota of eligible stores was met): random_bucket_flagged - random_bucket_drawn.
fig2a_not_drawn.check: equals flagged - verified; census_drawn + random_bucket_drawn == verified (both asserted)

fig2a_not_on_shopify.definition: Tranco top-N domains that the DNS rule did not flag as Shopify (neither the apex nor the www host resolved to Shopify's address block or a myshopify.com CNAME): design.tranco_top_n - fig2a_funnel.flagged.
fig2a_not_on_shopify.check: fig2a_funnel.tranco equals design.tranco_top_n; the difference is positive (both asserted)

fig2c_timeline.definition: Medians (ms, with the number of loads) over the analysed stores of the moments that vary by store: *_nav_to_load from navigation start to the load event; *_before_load from the banner becoming visible to the load event; *_from_load from the page's load event to the Decline click or to the reload's navigation. Default and GPC loads with a load event; Default loads with a visible banner; Decline loads with a click (banner, click, the reload, and the next page's load event from the raw records). Drawn in Fig 2c and stated in its caption.
fig2c_timeline.check: analysed stores = design.n_main; clicked loads = fig5.decline.clicked_all; banner loads = banner_A0; the raw next-navigation time equals loads.csv t_next_nav (+-1.5 ms) for >= 95% of the clicked loads (raw_matches_loads_csv); banners before the load event; 0 < click < reload (all asserted)
